acknowledgements.statement: This artifact evaluates documentary preapproval reviewer eligibility only. It does not perform either required independent AI review class.
An effective ELIGIBLE zero-violation result is necessary but not sufficient for GOV-002 PASS and does not itself publish a GOV-002 assertion result.
No candidate evidence root, qualifying AI review run, AI review coverage result, acceptance index, or final acceptance result is claimed to exist.
Neither eligibility nor a later GOV-002 PASS authorizes implementation, Phase 0 execution, Phase 0A work, provider access, paper operation, or live trading.
Preparing, validating, or approving this artifact is governance documentation work and is not a qualifying independent AI review run.

check_results.expected_condition: The effective role assignment resolves every required human Phase 0 owner and approver capacity to PROJECT-PRINCIPAL-001, discloses all overlaps, and does not imply additional human participants.
check_results.observed_condition: The exact role-assignment bytes contain 11 distinct required capacity assignments, every assignment resolves to PROJECT-PRINCIPAL-001, the human principal count is one, and the 11-capacity overlap group is declared complete.

check_results.expected_condition: The role assignment designates AI-REVIEW-PROCESS-001 and explicitly prevents principal self-review from being represented as independent review.
check_results.observed_condition: The exact role-assignment bytes designate AI-REVIEW-PROCESS-001, require two named review classes, and state that PROJECT-PRINCIPAL-001 self-review does not satisfy independent review.

check_results.expected_condition: The designated procedure ID resolves to AI-REVIEW-PROCESS-001, its exact SHA-256 equals the approved hash, and external attributable exact-hash principal approval exists.
check_results.observed_condition: The designated procedure ID and logical ID resolve to AI-REVIEW-PROCESS-001 and phase0.ai_review_procedure, the exact SHA-256 is EAAA84B1D0D6FF4B6A90F36CC35F5D88E9D1EB63173A6BDE18D9C911E63C69A8, and PROJECT-PRINCIPAL-001 approved those exact bytes in the external conversation.

check_results.expected_condition: The approved procedure requires two distinct fresh contexts, read-only governed inputs, non-authoring eligibility, sanitized evidence, complete coverage union, and exact candidate-root binding.
check_results.observed_condition: The exact procedure bytes define two review classes, separately initialized fresh contexts, read-only governed inputs, non-authoring rules, sanitized input and output boundaries, complete coverage-union rules, and exact candidate-root binding.

check_results.expected_condition: The approved procedure preserves the separation between preapproval GOV-002 evidence and postroot review-run and coverage evidence.
check_results.observed_condition: The exact procedure bytes restrict GOV-002 to preapproval evidence, exclude AI review runs and coverage from candidate-root inputs, and create those records only after candidate-root construction for the final gate.

check_results.expected_condition: The bound artifacts do not falsely claim that an actual AI review run, review coverage result, formal approval record, candidate root, acceptance index, or final result currently exists.
check_results.observed_condition: The exact bound bytes declare current AI review runs, review coverage, and the prior eligibility result as not yet created; they disclaim formal phase0.approval_records and make no current candidate-root, acceptance-index, or final-result claim.

effectivity.activation_condition: PROJECT-PRINCIPAL-001 explicitly approves this complete file by logical ID and exact SHA-256 after review.
effectivity.determination_rule: Effectivity is established by external attributable exact-hash principal-approval evidence. This file alone cannot prove activation.
effectivity.self_hash_rule: This file does not embed its own SHA-256 because that would create a circular identity. External approval evidence must record the computed hash.

governance_effect.gov002_reassessment_rule: After this unchanged valid ELIGIBLE zero-violation result becomes effective, GOV-002 may be reevaluated against all required evidence in a later governed assertion-evaluation run.
governance_effect.postroot_evidence_rule: Qualifying AI review runs and AI review coverage remain postroot final-gate evidence and are not inputs to this result or GOV-002.

supersession.revision_rule: After effectivity, any content change creates a new immutable revision and requires new exact-hash principal approval. Earlier approved bytes remain historical and cannot transfer approval to changed bytes.

validation_contract.additional_property_rule: Every contracted object rejects members not declared by the approved written specification for schema version 1.0.0.
validation_contract.aggregate_rule: INELIGIBLE applies when one or more checks FAIL; otherwise BLOCKED applies when one or more checks are BLOCKED; otherwise ELIGIBLE applies exactly when all six checks PASS and violation_count is zero.
validation_contract.array_ordering_rule: check_results preserves the exact required procedure-derived order; set-valued arrays are deduplicated and sorted lexicographically; acknowledgements are sorted by acknowledgement_id; authority_bindings are sorted by logical_id; violations are sorted by check_id, reason_code, then rule_ref.
validation_contract.authority_hash_rule: Every authority binding must resolve to the exact declared bytes before any check or aggregate may be relied upon.
validation_contract.count_consistency_rule: blocked_check_count, failed_check_count, and passed_check_count equal the corresponding check result counts, sum to required_check_count, and required_check_count equals six; violation_count equals violations length.
validation_contract.duplicate_key_rule: Reject any JSON object containing a duplicate member name.
validation_contract.evidence_resolution_rule: Every evidence_ref resolves within an exact authority binding; this result is not evidence for its own checks and postroot or future artifacts are prohibited inputs.
validation_contract.object_key_order_rule: Every object member name is sorted in ascending Unicode code-point order.
validation_contract.reason_code_rule: PASS has no reason codes; FAIL uses only the exact check-scoped failure registry; BLOCKED uses only REQUIRED_EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE; every violation corresponds to a FAIL check and uses one of that check's allowed failure codes.
